title: Confirmatory test of the one positive continent-control cell: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/continent_confirm_prereg.json has written continent_confirm_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
motivation: In the exploratory window-size sweep (results/_spectral/continent_ksweep, commit after d173331), one cell showed truth preferring the quiet tail more than a semantic control: truth_cities, mid layer, k = 0.10 d, control named_continent, mean Delta +0.076, 95% CI [+0.026, +0.125], 7 of 8 models readable. Neighbouring cells did not show it (k = 0.05, city_continent, final layer), and about one such cell was expected by chance among ~23 tested. This test asks whether that cell replicates on held-out statements.
held_out_data: truth_cities_negated, first 512 pairs ('The city of X is not in Y.'). Same cities, different statements, truth relation inverted against the named country. Not used in the exploratory sweep.

single_confirmatory_cell.control: named_continent (continent of the country named in the statement; UN M49, Oceania folded into Asia; data/country_continent.json)
single_confirmatory_cell.everything_else: identical to continent_control.py: published language-subset basis, last-token pooling, 10 windows, linear probe with five pair-grouped folds, retention, Delta = quiet-tail tilt(truth) - quiet-tail tilt(control), paired bootstrap 10,000 resamples. Cached activations reused (layers mid and final are both computed so the cache matches; final is reported, not tested).

cell_inclusion: A model enters only if (a) the thesis usable rule holds: truth headroom >= 0.10, shuffled floor check passes, control headroom > 0.02, Delta computable; and (b) the control is READABLE: its retention exceeds 0.10 in the top or the bottom window. Rule (b) is added because at k = 0.005 d the control was unreadable everywhere, which makes Delta the concept's own tilt rather than a specificity statistic.
validity_gate: The test is valid only if at least 6 of 8 models pass inclusion. Otherwise the result is reported as 'not testable' and no conclusion is drawn.
test: one-sample t-test of per-model Delta against 0, two-sided, alpha 0.05; Wilcoxon reported alongside; TOST with bounds +/-0.10 retention units. Reported with all included models and without gemma-2-2b.

decision_rule.replicates: 95% CI of mean Delta above 0 in both versions (all included models, and without gemma-2-2b)
decision_rule.does_not_replicate: 90% CI inside +/-0.10 in both versions, or 95% CI below 0

reporting: The result is reported whatever it is, alongside the exploratory sweep that motivated it. No other cell of this run is interpreted.
